name: FSFFL Season Simulator
hard_rules: Never hard-code the active league season in simulator logic.
Never use dynasty/redraft market value as a silent substitute for projected fantasy points.
Use exact league scoring and lineup configuration from data/league.json.
Use actual FSFFL schedule from the current season.
Fail validation when critical inputs are incomplete.
current_1_0_scope: Weeks 15-17 playoff simulation when projections exist
future_layers: injury-duration state transitions and bench substitution
automatic weekly updating and snapshot archive
